design: Leakage-safe rolling origin. For each target S, train through S-2, tune regularization on S-1, refit through S-1, score S. Retrained full process reference and each one-family ablation.
uncertainty: Paired per-game bootstrap stratified by target season; 10000 draws; intervals do not account for trying multiple ablations.
headline: Recent goal form, opponent adjustments, shots, and schedule inputs show consistent held-out value. Removing all xG has near-zero count-logloss change, reduces final-score logloss modestly, and slightly worsens team-goal MAE with interval including zero. 5v5 xG improves team-goal MAE but worsens final-score logloss when included.
